description: Modbus RTU gateway for Mitsubishi Heavy Industries air conditioners: on/off, mode, fan speed, vanes, setpoint, temperatures, alarms, error codes and gateway settings
source: HMS Networks / Intesis, INMBSMHI001R000 user manual

sources.title: INMBSMHI001R000 – Modbus RTU interface – User manual

notes: Modbus RTU over EIA-485. Function 03 or 04 reads, 06 or 16 writes. The baud rate and slave address are set with the DIP switches (factory: 9600 baud, 8N1).
Addresses are the protocol addresses of the manual (the PLC addresses less 1).
Temperatures are in °C or °F and in degrees or tenths of a degree, as set with the DIP switches; their entries say so.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.

registers.name: AC unit Fan Speed 1,2 Num. of Fan Speeds Value 4 3
registers.description: 1 (Default) 0 Auto 1 Low Low Low High 2 Mid Mid High - 3 High High - - 4 Powerful - - -

registers.name: AC unit Temperature Setpoint
registers.description: -32768 (Initialization value) ALL MODES (EXCEPT HEAT) 18..30ºC (ºC/x10ºC) 64..86ºF HEAT 16..30ºC (ºC/x10ºC) 61..61ºF Degrees or tenths of a degree, °C or °F, as set with the DIP switches; -32768 means not initialised.

registers.name: AC unit Temperature reference
registers.description: -32768 (Initialization value) 10..38ºC (ºC/x10ºC) 50..100ºF Degrees or tenths of a degree, °C or °F, as set with the DIP switches; -32768 means not initialised.

registers.name: AC unit Operation Time
registers.description: 0..65535 (hours). Counts the time the AC unit is in “On” state.

registers.name: Error Code
registers.description: 0: No active error 65532 (-4): Initialization process (around 2min) before normal operation starts. This error appears in case that Gateway is set as Master. 65535 (-1): Error in the communication of Gateway or Remote Controller with the AC unit. Any

registers.name: Indoor unit´s ambient temperature from external sensor (at Modbus side)
registers.description: -32768: (Initialization value). No temperature is being provided from an input sensor. There’s no input sensor. Any other: (ºC/x10ºC/ºF) Degrees or tenths of a degree, °C or °F, as set with the DIP switches; -32768 means not initialised.

registers.name: AC Real temperature setpoint
registers.description: When the mechanism for “Virtual temperature” is not being applied, the value will be the one in the register 5 (PLC addressing). 16..31ºC (ºC/x10ºC) 60..90ºF Degrees or tenths of a degree, °C or °F, as set with the DIP switches; -32768 means not initialised.

registers.name: Current AC max setpoint
registers.description: -32768 (Initialization value) Ranges are specific from Manufacturer Degrees or tenths of a degree, °C or °F, as set with the DIP switches; -32768 means not initialised.

registers.name: Current AC min setpoint
registers.description: -32768 (Initialization value) Ranges are specific from Manufacturer Degrees or tenths of a degree, °C or °F, as set with the DIP switches; -32768 means not initialised.

registers.name: Outdoor Intake temperature
registers.description: -32768d: (Initialization value) No temperature’s value is being provided outdoor. No virtual temperature is applied. Any other: (ºC/x10ºC/ºF) Degrees or tenths of a degree, °C or °F, as set with the DIP switches; -32768 means not initialised.

registers.name: Input reference temperature
registers.description: -32768: (Initialization value). No temperature’s value is being provided from an external sensor. No virtual temperature is applied. Any other: (ºC/x10ºC/ºF) Degrees or tenths of a degree, °C or °F, as set with the DIP switches; -32768 means not initialised.

registers.name: Return Path temperature
registers.description: -32768 (Initialization value) Any: (ºC/x10ºC/ºF) Degrees or tenths of a degree, °C or °F, as set with the DIP switches; -32768 means not initialised.

registers.name: Error address
registers.description: Provides the indoor unit number which is providing error
